title: Questions 153-154 refer to the following text-message chain.
passage_1:
Priya Ansari (3:05 P.M.)
I am a little nervous to be in charge of our booth at the upcoming International Science Festival next month. There are expected to be more than 20,000 visitors this year.

Owen Brennan (3:06 P.M.)
I know this is the first time you have organized a booth at an international event, but there is no need to worry. The ones you put together for the regional shows in Kendal and Truro were fairly excellent.

Priya Ansari (3:08 P.M.)
Thanks for the encouragement. Anyway, I am trying to make our booth memorable. I have just received a commitment from Dr. Halima Sow, the well-known robotics engineer, to demonstrate our new walking frame.

Owen Brennan (3:09 P.M.)
I have read every paper she has published.

Priya Ansari (3:10 P.M.)
Then ensure to be present at our booth at 11:00 A.M. on the first day of the festival.
